cause: Gate 1 requires live observations and separate automated verification.
decision: Accept operator-reported staging passes with unknown deployed revision, alongside automated regression evidence tied separately to the tested source. This does not approve deployment, administrative access, or browser acceptance. Carry low-bandwidth sign-in to Gate 7 and safe attempt limiting to Gate 8.
observed_result: Operator reports PASS for revoke and reactivate in an approved staging session. No individual staging assertions or separate timestamp were supplied.
regression_test: GoogleSsoTest: revoked approval blocks relogin and existing access. SsoReactivationTest: reactivation restores only the original redeemed Google identity. AuthAcceptanceTest: event-write failure rolls back revocation clear.
limitations: Staging deployed revision is unknown. The source SHA and CI run identify automated verification only. The full PHP run reported 54 passes and two skips; no skipped case is claimed here.
